snippet.title: WARTILE Switch Trailer - A Miniature Viking Strategy Game
snippet.description:
Wartile on Switch is available in the US now, an invasion of Europe will follow soon! Embark on a journey through a miniature universe inspired by Norse mythology! At its core, Wartile offers a cool-down based combat system set in handcrafted dioramas. The tabletop atmosphere is created by fusing a tilt-shift look and an impressive amount of detail. Build a deck of active spells, gather loot, gear up your vikings and follow a quest to find the cure for a plague which has infested the northern lands!

Wartile on Switch: https://www.nintendo.com/games/detail/wartile-switch/
Wartile on PC: https://store.steampowered.com/app/404200/WARTILE/
